summary: Iter85 — verified the coach's newly-added REMOVE_EXERCISE / SWAP_EXERCISE / ADD_EXERCISE write-actions end-to-end plus the honesty rule + Today cache invalidation flow. BACKEND (11/11 pytest in test_iter85_coach_writeactions.py): ADD_EXERCISE happy path (added-ex-* id, sanitized name/category/sets/reps, tag stripped, other write-actions null); REMOVE_EXERCISE prescribed (kind='prescribed', targetName='Romanian Deadlift', sessionExerciseId matches the plan's — verified against GET /api/plan/session/today AND full plan doc from GET /api/programs/{planId}: no mutation to plan today OR future weeks); REMOVE_EXERCISE for a coach-added exercise via current_session snapshot (kind='added', partial name match works); Ambiguity guard: seeded snapshot with two 'row' entries → the model itself asked 'Which row? You've got Barbell Row and Chest Supported Row' and removed_exercise stayed null (no tag emitted — honesty guard is working through the system prompt); SWAP happy path (removed+added present, category inherited from prescribed's 'main', plan unchanged); Honesty rule for out-of-scope 'delete week 3' request (all three write-action fields null, response text mentions ⋮ menu / PROGRAM_CHANGE / can't); resolve_coach_remove_target unit tests (empty/junk → not_found, exact+partial prescribed matches, ambiguous list of matches, added-store match); a bogus-name remove request (e.g. 'Remove Zorglax Trombone') does not phantom-remove anything. FRONTEND: verified via Expo web preview (Playwright, mobile viewport) — logged in as test_strongman via /api/auth/login, cleared today_skipped_exercises + today_pending_invalidation, called /api/coach/chat with the REMOVE prompt directly (200, removed_exercise shape is exactly {kind:'prescribed', targetName:'Romanian Deadlift', sessionExerciseId:'7b08a025-c4a', source:'coach'}), replayed the coach.tsx client-side persistence (AsyncStorage.today_skipped_exercises → {"date":"2026-07-20","skipped":[{"sessionExerciseId":"7b08a025-c4a","name":"Romanian Deadlift"}]}, today_pending_invalidation timestamp set), navigated to /(tabs)/today: Today's set count dropped from 0/33 → 0/28 (matches RDL's 5 sets), body no longer contains 'Romanian Deadlift', AND today_pending_invalidation was CLEARED to null on focus — full invalidation flow verified. RN Web deprecation warnings (pre-existing carry-over): expo-av must migrate to expo-audio / expo-video per SDK 54.

minor.issue: When Claude emits ONLY a write-action tag with no surrounding prose (frequently the case for REMOVE_EXERCISE), backend strips the tag and returns response='' (empty string). The frontend masks this in coach.tsx line 508 with `(result.response || 'No response received.')`, but 'No response received.' is a poor confirmation for a user who just asked to remove an exercise. Recommend: (a) tighten the system prompt to REQUIRE a one-sentence confirmation for REMOVE_EXERCISE/SWAP_EXERCISE (already stated for ADD but the model doesn't always comply for REMOVE), OR (b) have the backend synthesize a default confirmation ('Removed <name> from today') when clean_response ends up empty after tag stripping AND a write-action fired. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:4924, 4955, 4997.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated in SDK 54 — console emits '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the `expo-audio` and `expo-video` packages'. Pre-existing (carried over from iter83/iter84). Reference: /app/frontend/package.json expo-av dependency.

action_items: OPTIONAL / QoL — tighten the honesty rule OR synthesize a fallback confirmation so users don't see 'No response received.' when a REMOVE/SWAP tag was emitted alone. Suggested spot: right after the write-action parse blocks in /app/backend/server.py, if not clean_response.strip() and (removed_exercise or swap_exercise or added_exercise), assign a canonical one-liner (e.g. f"Removed {removed_exercise['targetName']} from today's session.").

No further action required for the write-action, honesty, or invalidation-flow features — all pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: The three write-action parsers (ADD/REMOVE/SWAP at server.py:4919-5058) correctly (i) always strip the tag from clean_response regardless of JSON validity, (ii) sanitize via validate_coach_added_exercise, (iii) resolve prescribed vs added via resolve_coach_remove_target with a normalized substring match, (iv) surface ambiguity as a plain-text clarifying note without emitting the tag, (v) never mutate the plan / DB — REMOVE is a client-side skip and SWAP is an atomic client-side remove+add. Plan unchanged assertion verified against full /api/programs/{planId} snapshots before/after.

The system prompt (server.py:4770-4815) correctly lists the exact three write actions, forbids narrating unowned ones, forbids emitting more than one tag per turn, and forbids emitting separate REMOVE+ADD in place of SWAP. In live testing Claude followed all three constraints across ~35 calls.

Category inheritance for SWAP is implemented (server.py:5017-5030): when the model leaves add.category blank and the removed exercise is prescribed with a known section, the backend fills it in with the mapping {primary/speed → main}, else uses the model's chosen valid category.

coach.tsx (lines 440-503) mirrors the backend shape exactly: prescribed removes call persistCoachRemovePrescribed (skip-list), added removes call persistCoachRemoveAdded (deletes from today_added_exercises), SWAP does remove-then-add and only writes the add if the remove succeeded (correct atomicity given the two-store split). markTodayNeedsRefresh() is called once at the end if any mutation happened — good.

today.tsx correctly consumes today_pending_invalidation at focus (verified: after Playwright navigated to /(tabs)/today, the key went from a Date.now() timestamp to null). Skip-list filter is applied in the full rebuild path AND the mount-restore path with a date guard that purges yesterday's entries.

The current_session snapshot parser (server.py:4855-4881) correctly reads only exercises listed under the 'Exercises the athlete added to today' header and stops at the first blank line — safe against injection.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (invalidation + skip-list flow verified end-to-end via Playwright + real /api/coach/chat call)

rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found. The only deviation is a UX weakness: when Claude emits a REMOVE_EXERCISE (or SWAP_EXERCISE) tag as the ENTIRE reply with no confirmation prose, backend clean_response.rstrip() at server.py:4955/4997 leaves an empty string. Frontend then displays the RN fallback 'No response received.' which is confusing next to a successfully removed exercise. Suggested one-line fix at end of the REMOVE_EXERCISE branch: `if not clean_response.strip() and removed_exercise: clean_response = f"Removed {removed_exercise['targetName']} from today's session."` and analogous synthesized confirmations for ADD and SWAP. This is a nice-to-have; the write-action itself lands correctly and the plan stays untouched.
